target_persona: Engineering Managers, Tech Leads & Technical Recruiters

steps.name: Initial Direct Pitch
steps.subject: Quick question regarding {role} at {company} - {candidateName}
steps.objective: Establish skill relevance, highlight quantifiable achievements, request brief conversation.

steps.name: Value-Add & Case Study
steps.subject: Thought on {company}'s engineering stack - {candidateName}
steps.objective: Share technical insights or code repository link to prove expertise.

steps.name: Soft Nudge
steps.subject: Re: {role} at {company}

steps.name: Graceful Breakup
steps.subject: Permission to close the loop - {candidateName}
